title: Elf Bar 600 Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Ice Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Designed for use with the Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pods provide a simple and efficient way to enjoy Elf Bar’s top flavours in a cost-effective format. Each 2ml prefilled pod delivers up to 600 puffs, depending on personal usage, and contains 20mg nic salt e-liquid for a smooth, satisfying mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw and rapid nicotine relief. Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Ice Flavour: A vibrant medley of bold berries. Sweet strawberry and tangy raspberry are layered with the rich depth of cherry, while a cooling exhale adds an icy twist for a refreshingly smooth vape. Swapping pods is quick and effortless—just click a fresh one into place and vape. Whether you're moving away from disposables or looking for a convenient way to enjoy consistently great flavour, these prefilled pods maintain the quality and reliability that vapers expect from Elf Bar.
